fields.notes: ARINC 429 does not specify DFT / scan / BIST at the protocol layer. Protocol-level self-checking is provided by (a) odd parity per 32-bit word over bits 1-31, (b) BRZ self-clocking with mandatory mid-bit return-to-zero edge, (c) ≥ 4-bit-time NULL inter-word gap framing, (d) SSM (bits 30-31) per-word health flags (NO / NCD / FT / FW), and (e) the natural periodic re-transmission cadence of avionics labels per equipment-type spec. Commercial transceiver / controller IP (Holt HI-3584 with built-in loopback BIT mode, AIM GmbH, Condor Engineering) adds standard scan insertion + BIT (Built-In-Test) modes at the integrator level, but those are device-specific and not defined by ARINC 429 itself.
